title: You’re not waiting…
paragraphs:
You’re not waiting…
you’re being exposed.

Because if God gave it to you right now—
would you still need Him?

Or would you replace Him…
with the very blessing you prayed for?

There are prayers you whispered with tears…
but if God answered them instantly,
your heart might drift faster than your miracle.
This is where it gets uncomfortable.

Because what feels like delay…
might actually be mercy.

You see others getting married.
Getting promoted.
Getting breakthroughs.

Still praying.
Still waiting.
Still wondering if God even hears you.

But what if heaven is not ignoring you…
but protecting you?

Some of us don’t just need a blessing.
We need transformation.

Because without it—
the same pride, the same hidden sin, the same wounded identity…
will sabotage what God gives.
And we don’t talk about that enough.

We shout about breakthrough.
But stay silent about brokenness.

You want the door open.
God is dealing with what’s inside you before you walk through it.
“He has made everything beautiful in its time. Also, He has put eternity into man’s heart, yet so that he cannot find out what God has done from the beginning to the end.”

Not just beautiful.
But in its time.

God’s timing is not random.
It is intentional.
Precise.
Surgical.
Some scholars interpret this verse to mean that God allows seasons of confusion and waiting so that we learn to trust Him—not our understanding.

Because if you could figure everything out…
you wouldn’t need faith.

And without faith—
you cannot please God.

📖 Hebrews 11:6
“Without faith it is impossible to please Him…”
Because this isn’t just about waiting.
This is about what’s being revealed in you while you wait.

“Why them, not me?”
“God, did You forget me?”
“Maybe I’m not enough…”
And here’s the truth most people won’t tell you:

That relationship.
That dream.
That version of your life.
You started to need it to feel complete.
And anything you need more than God…

Not always in obvious rebellion—
but in quiet replacement.
And God, in His mercy, says:
“No… you’ll be okay when you find your life in Me.”
Because the greatest delay in history…
For generations, people waited for a Savior.
And it seemed like heaven was silent.

📖 Galatians 4:4–5
“But when the fullness of time had come, God sent forth His Son… to redeem those who were under the law.”

The pride.
The hidden struggles.
The quiet compromises no one else sees.

📖 Romans 3:23
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.”
We don’t just need better timing.
Jesus didn’t wait for you to be ready.
He stepped in while you were still broken.

📖 Romans 5:8
“But God shows His love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.”

Jesus lived the life you couldn’t live.
Died the death you deserved.
And rose again so you could have new life.
the invitation is not just to wait for blessings.
Because here’s the breakthrough you didn’t expect:
When you finally let go of control…
you discover that God was never late.
You were just being led somewhere deeper.
What if this season isn’t punishment…
What if God is not holding you back…
is where your heart finally learns:
everything else finds its proper place.

📖 Matthew 6:33
“Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.”
To repent of the ways you’ve tried to control the timeline.
To release the idols you’ve been quietly holding.
To come back—not just to blessings—
Say it in your own words:

“Lord… I surrender.
Your timing. Your will. Your way.
Not mine.”
Because when you place your life in His hands—

you will look back at this season
and realize—
If this spoke directly to you…
If this stirred something in you…
